- **August 27, 2026:** Moderna issued a press release announcing the proposed private placement of **$2.0 billion of convertible senior notes**. The company entered into capped call transactions in connection with pricing the Notes.
- **August 28, 2026:** Moderna issued a press release announcing the pricing of an **upsized $2.6 billion offering of convertible senior notes**. The initial purchasers exercised their option to purchase additional Notes in full.
- **September 1, 2026:** Moderna completed the private offering, issuing **$3.0 billion aggregate principal amount** of **0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032**, including the additional $400 million from the initial purchasers’ option. The Notes were issued under an indenture dated September 1, 2026, between Moderna and U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as trustee.

| Offering detail | Information |
|---|---|
| Issuer | Moderna, Inc. |
| Notes | 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032 |
| Aggregate principal amount issued | $3,000,000,000 |
| Maturity date | March 1, 2032, unless earlier converted, redeemed or repurchased |
| Regular interest | None; principal amount does not accrete |
| Special interest | May accrue under circumstances and at rates provided in the Indenture; payable semiannually on March 1 and September 1, beginning March 1, 2027, if applicable |
| Initial conversion rate | 4.7487 shares of common stock per $1,000 principal amount |
| Initial conversion price | Approximately $210.58 per share |
| Conversion-price premium | Approximately 47.5% over the August 27, 2026 last reported common-stock sale price of $142.77 |
| Shares issuable based on initial conversion rate | 14,246,100 shares |
| Maximum shares issuable in limited circumstances | 21,012,600 shares |
| Redemption | Generally not before September 6, 2029, except for a cleanup redemption; optional redemption may occur on or after September 6, 2029 and before the 21st scheduled trading day before maturity, subject to conditions |
| Fundamental-change repurchase price | 100% of principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid special interest, if any |
| Net proceeds | Approximately $2,957.3 million, after initial purchasers’ discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses |
| Capped-call transaction cost | $328.8 million |
| Intended use of remaining proceeds | General corporate purposes, potentially including investment in the growth of the oncology business and repayment of debt |
| Offering exemptions | Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and Rule 144A for resale to qualified institutional buyers |
| Registration status | Notes and shares issuable upon conversion were not registered under the Securities Act; Moderna does not intend to file a resale registration statement |

The filing treats the transaction as a **material capital-structure event**: it is reported under **Item 1.01—Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement**, **Item 2.03—Creation of Direct Financial Obligation or an Obligation under an Off-Balance Sheet Arrangement of a Registrant**, and **Item 3.02—Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities**. The Notes are general senior unsecured obligations of Moderna.

The filing also states that the company entered into capped call transactions on **August 27, 2026** and **August 28, 2026**. The capped calls cover, subject to customary adjustments, the shares initially underlying the Notes and are expected generally to reduce potential dilution or offset certain cash payments upon conversion. The initial cap price was approximately **$392.62 per share**, representing a **175.0% premium** over the August 27, 2026 common-stock price of $142.77.
